newsitem.title: USA: Sparks corn acres at 80.8 mln, soy 65.98 mln-trade.
newsitem.headline: Sparks corn acres at 80.8 mln, soy 65.98 mln-trade.

text.p: Sparks Companies estimated 1997/98 U.S. corn planted acreage at 80.8 million acres, soybean acreage at 65.98 million and spring wheat acreage at 18.59 million, trade sources said.
Sparks officials would not comment on the figures.

Sparks' corn acreage estimate is very close to the 81 million acres USDA estimated during its annual Outlook Conference last month. Sparks' soybean estimate is up from USDA's conference estimate of 65.3 million.
USDA will release its first planting intentions report for the 1997/98 crop year on March 31.
The Memphis-based firm's spring wheat acreage estimate was below the 20 million acres planted a year ago.
